Hall can prove preservation of a real relic within Severin hands but incomplete intervening history between service-house recovery and modern reliquary remains unproved; no automatic legal ownership verdict for either House Severin or Vaishnavi. Edric independently accepts source limits and contextualizes 23 years of investigating Vaishnavi history from his established NPC profile, not claiming twenty-three continuous years in the current room or eyewitness status. Finer documentary comparison already succeeded on actual earlier Investigation16 and no separately uncertain new material requiring additional dice, so NO reroll, no spell or Guidance use and NO new original source roll.

Source prep specifically says the independent ORSAVEN survey FIELD BOOK needs actual future physical copy delivered by ordinary professional courier for reliable route correlation. At DAY28915:35 Edric's earlier signed written copy request is STILL QUEUED for NEXT ORDINARY HOUSE OUTGOING POST, no confirmed departure/receipt/survey copy/ETA despite passage of less than one hour; no V fee. 
The player's continued useful archival inquiry causes EDric to mention a precommitted additional professional incentive from prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md 'Hall/source contract': an INDEPENDENT scholarly recovery fund with TOTAL1200gp RESERVED FOR FUTURE EARNED EVIDENCE, broken down proposed400gp for authenticated comparison/documentary copies and800gp for credible field crossing-site record that preserves living current residents' access/rights. Edric knows potential scholarly commission and can refer V to local fund representative, but does NOT personally bind the fund nor pay anything; no funding application, patron interview, contractual request, agreed conditions, payment, retainer, or quest acceptance yet. Presentation is a real actionable LEAD independent of Lord Severin fealty talk and not automatic consequence of V completing today's already-played documentary work. Do not promise that earlier comparison has earned400gp without agreed commissioned originals/evidence return. This is NOT new treasure in Hall or a payment from estate/crown, and no 1200gp added to personal purse. 
Family politics remains latest: V proposed allied House Severin under senior restored Vaishnavi with house identity/current own estates/legal privileges protected, reciprocal collaboration; steward Edric willing advocate to Lord Severin who has been informed of V's arrival but no independent actual reply/appearance/acceptance yet; Elara signed eight-clause Rethwyn–Vaishnavi PRIVATE compact with Cirren carrying original, formal registered marriage/Crown recognition not confirmed.
